tasks.ask: From sf_ops.incidents where kind='machine_overheat', group by false_alarm; count incidents, sum downtime_min, and sum cost_usd to compare false alarms versus confirmed overheat events.

Join sf_ops.incidents kind='machine_overheat' to sf_plant.machine_telemetry on machine_id and date_trunc('HOUR', incidents.ts)=telemetry.ts; count incidents with telemetry.failure=1 or heat_dissipation_failure=1 versus no signal.

Join sf_ops.incidents kind='machine_overheat' to sf_plant.weather_hourly on date_trunc('HOUR', incidents.ts)=weather.ts; compare mean temperature and share above 30C for overheat alarms versus other incident kinds.
